column1: # The rule engine (src/ben.rs) handles the open class off the stem
# (the citation/verbal-noun form minus its final -আ), plus the fully
# productive -আনো causatives. This table carries the two closed sets the
#   1. RAISING monosyllabic roots — the mid root vowel এ/ও raises to
#      ই/উ everywhere except the তুমি/সে/আপনি present and the verbal
#      noun (ওঠা: উঠি but ওঠে; কেনা: কিনি but কেনে). Whether a mid-vowel
#      root raises is lexical (কেনা→কিন raises, দেখা→দেখ does not), so
#   2. VOWEL-final monosyllabic roots (-ওয়া / হ) — খাওয়া, দেওয়া … are
#      irregular across several stems (present খাই but past খেলাম,
#      perfect খেয়ে; যাওয়া is suppletive in the past গেলাম / perfect
#      গিয়ে). Their stems are stored explicitly.
# A `-` cell falls through to the rule. Columns:
#   base        present তুমি/সে/আপনি stem   (default: the plain stem)
#   high        present আমি/তুই + future    (default: the plain stem)
#   past_stem   simple past + conditional   (default: high; ল geminates)
#   prog        progressive base incl. ছ/চ্ছ (default: high+ছ)
# --- raising roots (এ→ই, ও→উ): store the two grades, rest by rule ---
# --- vowel-final roots (-ওয়া / হ): stems stored explicitly ---
